G57's reading 10, stated while reading P19's 60 restrict lines (windows r728_000 and r728_030, each with its full how), before their rows are written; not an amendment. The labelers marked all 60 as corrections. Their conditions narrow P19 to rooms where approval was granted, the guest lives under the host's rule, the rule is enforced, lasts, or binds every placer of the host, or the host's authority is undisputed. P19's statement names the guest's request, the host's ruling and the dispute over who may approve as its acts, and its range runs from 'a small room asking to slip into a neighbour's lot'; it claims no granted approval, no enforcement, no lasting residence and no host that binds all its placers. So none of these conditions is one P19 lacks (G9): each line is a specification where its concepts show P19, and an evidence limit where they do not. No line corrects P19, so §2's trigger is not met. A host's member who grants leave while another calls to destroy the guest, or who lacks authority to speak for the host, or who disclaims control over its repeaters, rules with a dispute (newzealand c0246, c0247; uoft c0133; rainbowgrid c0003; FloydVsVoid c0128). A room that says the space is not its to lend disputes who may approve (rpi c0114). Not shown, so an evidence limit: building beside a host's work with its leave (lakers-032, P08), a visitor's plea to stay off its drawing (lakers-033, P07), and a start inside another room's mark with no one named who may allow it (kingdomhearts-040). How many rooms show only a request, with no ruling, is a census question. Next: P19-restrict-spec.txt

G57's reading 11, stated while reading P19's 37 add-condition lines (windows a451_000 and a451_019, with full how), before their rows are written; not an amendment. Under G4a, a condition that P19's statement already holds makes a specification. P19's statement names the request, the ruling and the dispute over who may approve, and claims no installed work, no enforcement, no lasting protection, no reason for a ruling and no host that binds all its members. So these are held: a request or an offer of protection with no grant seen (AmericanFlaginPlace-041, Jamaica-064, flashtv-019, zelda-018); a refusal the host cannot enforce, or one enacted by removing pixels (PurplePixels-022, ainbowroad-025); the grounds of a ruling, such as early help, fit with the nation, the host's pattern, upkeep, the host's own threat or the earlier occupant's right (anarcho_capitalism-022, placeDE-057, placeportalpattern-023, theexpanse-037, warthunder-028, ireland-050, ireland-051); a colour condition, a vote or a purity demand that revises a grant (orderofthebluecorner-028, thebluecorner-031, greenlattice-040), which the census marks CO; and a host whose members are divided on a grant, or whose placers reject or do not know an approved guest (clubpenguin-053, greenlattice-028, malta-016, rotmg-021, seolhyun-054, thailand-016, norway-022). The last kind is also P21's, members stating that one agreement does not bind every placer; P19's dispute clause holds it, so the lines are specifications and the overlap with P21 goes to the census. A request cut off by the close stays a request (tokyo-012, AC). A member's own piece in the room's work is P02, as in stevenuniverse-036 (stevenuniverse-037). Next: P19-addcond-spec-1.txt and -2.txt

G57's reading 12, stated while reading P19's 17 add-step lines (window s488_000) and 6 link lines (window l722_000), with full how, before their rows are written; not an amendment. Add-step: every step proposed is an act P19's statement names, in an order it does not fix, so each line is a specification (G4a): an application, a review, a conditional grant, a referral and the build (PlaceNL-029), a host redirecting a guest's design (AvoArmy-029), seeking refuge before having a mark (ainbowroad-024), the work completed before approval, F-012's reverse order (gamindustri-017), a host publishing a form, an approved list and a no-build diagram (greenlattice-013), places reserved for rooms whose art the host built over (placestart-025), repeated requests and refusals (planetside-021), and permission relayed to the host's maintainers and bots (starcitizen-024). Link: a refusal followed by the guest's move (finland-019) and a request ended by the close (tokyo-014) are held by P19's range, which claims no order. Applications to the faction on a new lattice after the close carry the hosting onto a later canvas, which P13 states (greenlattice-055), a specification naming P13. Two link lines make a host's ruling on guests depend on its colour faith, purity or holy ground (orderofthebluecorner-040, thebluecorner-066); no element or arrow states that link, and each line pairs the other, so both are paired elaborations (G4a's last clause). It is the head's contrary condition, a faith deciding whom a room admits, now shown in two rooms' link lines beside K04's particular TeamYellowPlace-023. A link from a canvas judged too full (K02) to asking a host is shown in one link line only (tokyo-013), a particular. Next: P19-addstep-spec.txt and P19-link-spec.txt
